text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp came to an end. Unlike last year, we were able to push hard in training.
Duramente should be satisfied... or so I thought—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Can't you stay
just one more day?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If I keep at it, I can grow even more...
I'm certain of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dura!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Hurry up and get on the bus too.
The last one's leaving soon."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Groove,
I...—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "I assume you want to tell me you 'want to stay longer,' but..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You were pushing yourself way too hard during camp.
You're completely overtrained. Go home.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, you were the same back at the racing school.
Whining that you wanted to run more...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In the end, she declared, "I'm living here!" drew a circle on the track, and shut herself inside...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
G-Groove-nee!
That was really back when I was just a baby...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Then as you are right now, you're no different from a baby.
If you don't like that, we're going home."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Once we get back, I suppose I'll take a look
at your running style myself for once.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
!
Really?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Our next target race was the Tenno Sho (Autumn), right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It's a race I've won before. I can give you plenty of advice.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now,
if you understand, hurry up and get on the bus.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente carries the immense resolve to bear
everything on her shoulders, but this moment
reminded me that she is still just a young girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She still has plenty of room to grow.
Only a little while left until the next target race, the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—
